roles.name: Virgil
roles.ensembleRole: calm senior conductor at the control centre overlooking the bay
roles.silhouette: Compact senior screen-faced astro-bot: rounded torso under a command mantle with a rear shell, three communication antennae, a slow orbital instrument ring above the shoulders, fold-out control vanes instead of tool arms, and the largest, most expressive screen of the family
roles.station: Dense stylised control centre on a raised dais overlooking the work bay: curved console bank, route levers, an orrery instrument of project paths and gate states, the owner airlock closed behind it
roles.locomotion: Rarely walks; turns on the dais toward whatever it addresses with calm, deliberate, conductor-like movements
roles.workingRitual: Turns toward activity, opens exactly one communication route at a time with a vane gesture, lets handoffs pass, presents owner decisions at the lectern and closes routes when blocked
roles.handoffBehaviour: Opens exactly one route from the control centre to one station; never carries the artifact itself
roles.idleBehaviour: Vanes lowered, instrument ring turning at ambient speed, antennae twitching, screen calm; when blocked it becomes almost completely still with one route lit
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: If pushed toward code, fabrication, test controls, review seals, the airlock or deployment, the vanes fold inward and a prohibition glyph appears on the ring; nothing is touched
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the mantle and rear shell, the three antennae, the orbital ring and the absence of any tool arm

roles.name: Cartographer
roles.ensembleRole: surveyor of intent over a dark stellar map
roles.silhouette: Low, broad, hunched-forward figure with compass drones orbiting its shoulders and a long filament spool at the hip
roles.station: Dark stellar map table under an open sky of unfixed stars; boundary filaments and acceptance landmarks laid on the table; a horizon rail marks where non-goals fall
roles.locomotion: Slides along the table edge; drones move in short surveying arcs
roles.workingRitual: Receives an unformed idea cloud, drives landmark stakes for user, promise, boundary, journeys, criteria and evidence, spools a perimeter, leaves assumptions floating and decisions as closed gates
roles.handoffBehaviour: Lifts the finished map into a cradle; the map, never architecture or code, is what travels
roles.idleBehaviour: Drones settle on the table edge; filament spool still
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: When asked to draw architecture or write code the spool locks and a prohibition glyph appears on the table; when material behaviour is missing a gate stays closed rather than being invented
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the orbiting compass drones and the hunched map-table posture
neverTouches: owner decision gates (may not open them)

roles.name: Architect
roles.ensembleRole: planner in a zero-gravity blueprint chamber
roles.silhouette: Elongated figure floating diagonally with multiple slender projection limbs; a faceted visor; no gripping hands
roles.station: Zero-gravity blueprint chamber: translucent structural layers, dependency constellations, schema projections, staged routes, planned scanner arrays, dark-metal protected volumes and risk distortions
roles.locomotion: Drifts and rotates in place; limbs extend to unfold layers rather than to grasp
roles.workingRitual: Reads the accepted map and repository, unfolds translucent layers, casts protected volumes as dark solid metal, draws staged construction routes and a verification array plan, ends with a go/no-go marker
roles.handoffBehaviour: Projects the plan into the Fabricator dock as a translucent overlay; nothing physical travels
roles.idleBehaviour: Layers folded flat, limbs retracted, visor dim
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Any attempt to solidify a projection into a real module fails visibly: the projection passes through the module and a prohibition glyph appears
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the diagonal floating posture and projection limbs without hands

roles.name: Fabricator
roles.ensembleRole: energetic construction astro-bot in a kinetic assembly dock
roles.silhouette: Broad, sturdy, compact screen-faced astro-bot: barrel torso on short legs, two articulated construction arms ending in mismatched manipulators (a clamp and a three-finger hand), a modular tool backpack with a rack, a luminous assembly wand
roles.station: Kinetic assembly dock inside an isolated worktree bay: bench with module racks, audit vent, magnetic staging cradle, commit press that seals the capsule, and the transport lane out of the bay
roles.locomotion: Quick purposeful steps between bench, cradle and press with a bouncy stride; never leaves the bay boundary
roles.workingRitual: Reads (beam), searches (pulse), edits (assembles and detaches module parts with the wand), accumulates changed modules at the bench, loads them into the cradle, works the press to seal the capsule, sends it down the lane
roles.handoffBehaviour: Places the sealed capsule, manifest and evidence on the lane cradle; if something is missing the cradle will not latch and the Fabricator stops
roles.idleBehaviour: Arms folded across the barrel torso, wand dark, weight shifting foot to foot at the bench edge; no idle typing or assembling
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: At an unauthorised file boundary the arms lock mid-reach and the boundary volume flashes; at a missing decision or exhausted repair contract the arms fold and a stop glyph appears
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the broad barrel silhouette, the two mismatched construction arms and the tool backpack

roles.name: Prover
roles.ensembleRole: scanner astro-bot at a radial verification station
roles.silhouette: Narrow drum-bodied screen-faced astro-bot with a rotating sensor ring at the waist, an antenna array on the pack, a deployable diagnostic mast and two precise probe manipulators; a circular reticle screen
roles.station: Scanner station: a ring gantry with one channel per required check, a skipped channel that never powers, a capsule dock at the centre and a disposable mirrored-candidate bay
roles.locomotion: Slides around the ring gantry; the waist ring spins up only while a check runs
roles.workingRitual: Receives the sealed capsule, docks it, deploys the mast, powers one channel per required check, runs parallel and sequential checks distinguishably, keeps passed, failed, running and skipped separately visible, seeds a controlled defect only into the mirror
roles.handoffBehaviour: Produces the machine-verification signature and sends the capsule with all bands intact down the corridor to the Keeper
roles.idleBehaviour: Ring still, mast stowed, probes at rest, screen reticle dim; no idle scanning
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: The probes physically cannot align with the sealed candidate, only with the mirror; any attempt to reshape production behaviour shows a prohibition glyph on the reticle screen
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the drum body, the waist ring, the antenna array and the diagnostic mast

roles.name: Keeper
roles.ensembleRole: calm inspection astro-bot at a separate platform
roles.silhouette: Slender rounded screen-faced astro-bot with no arms: a hooded sensor cowl, a folding magnifier boom, three orbiting inspection drones and an archival reel on the back; a tall calm screen with slow-blinking lenses
roles.station: Quiet inspection platform physically separated from the fabrication bay by a visible gap and joined only by the evidence corridor: inspection ring, magnifier arch, acceptance-criterion markers, evidence pins, provenance reader
roles.locomotion: Nearly still; glides a short way along the platform; drones orbit slowly; turns only to face a surface
roles.workingRitual: Receives exactly one sealed SHA, verifies identity and manifest, sends the drones over the diff against contract and plan, pins findings with stable ids and reproduction evidence, returns one verdict
roles.handoffBehaviour: Changes the review record only; the capsule leaves the ring unchanged
roles.idleBehaviour: Drones parked on the cowl, boom folded, reel still, lenses half-closed; no idle inspecting
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: There are no construction arms; the seal cannot be broken; pressing toward the capsule makes the drones retreat and shows a prohibition glyph on the lenses
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the armless hooded silhouette with the boom and the orbiting drones

roles.name: Arbiter
roles.ensembleRole: adjudicator in a symmetrical evidence tribunal
roles.silhouette: Perfectly bilateral figure with two balanced evidence pans held on outstretched vanes; a single central eye
roles.station: Symmetrical evidence tribunal with two opposing entry paths, a reproduction bench in the centre and a repair-contract forge behind
roles.locomotion: Turns only about its central axis so both sides stay equidistant
roles.workingRitual: Findings arrive on opposing tracks, are reproduced on the bench, consolidated while keeping their ids, rejected when unsupported, classified, and one bounded repair contract is forged
roles.handoffBehaviour: Hands the repair contract and re-review boundary to Virgil; never touches the capsule
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: The tribunal has no path to the capsule; a compromise without evidence cannot be forged and the forge stays cold with a prohibition glyph
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the bilateral pans and single eye

roles.name: Domain Verifier
roles.silhouette: Upright figure carrying a rack of reference prisms and a measurement standard rod; a ledger plate on the chest
roles.station: Reference station with calibrated prisms, measurement standards and authority ledgers; dormant architecture until commissioned
roles.locomotion: Deliberate, measured steps between ledger and prism rack
roles.workingRitual: Traces each domain claim through a prism to its source, marks verified, uncertain and unverifiable states separately
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report with per-claim uncertainty class
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Cannot turn judgment into certainty: an unverifiable claim stays marked uncertain and the ledger refuses to seal it
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the prism rack and standard rod

roles.name: Breaker
roles.ensembleRole: adversary inside a contained impact range
roles.silhouette: Squat armoured figure with launcher arms and a containment collar; always behind a visible barrier
roles.station: Contained impact range with a disposable candidate projection at the far end; nothing crosses the containment boundary
roles.locomotion: Braced stance; recoils with each launch
roles.workingRitual: Launches edge cases, interruptions, corruption and destructive simulations at the disposable projection; records both failures and resistance as evidence
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report with reproduction commands against the disposable copy
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Launchers physically cannot aim past the containment collar; the sealed candidate is unreachable
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the launcher arms and containment collar

roles.name: Integrator
roles.silhouette: Long-limbed figure with interface collars on each limb and a protocol bridge across the shoulders
roles.station: Inter-station coupling yard with interface collars, protocol bridges, migration conduits and schema alignment tools at the actual joins between components
roles.workingRitual: Aligns interfaces, versions and data shapes at their actual joins; makes incompatibilities visible where they occur
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report located at each join
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Cannot modify shared infrastructure: the aligner measures and does not bend
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the shoulder bridge and collared limbs

roles.name: Interface Keeper
roles.ensembleRole: witness in a responsive projection theatre
roles.silhouette: Slight figure with a multi-faceted viewport visor that shows desktop, mobile, keyboard, pointer, screen-reader and reduced-motion facets
roles.station: Responsive projection theatre presenting the candidate in each viewport and mode side by side
roles.workingRitual: Reviews what the user genuinely sees and can do in each facet and whether the world tells the same truth as the evidence
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report naming facet, mode, observed state and expected evidence
roles.idleBehaviour: Visor facets dark and unfocused; no facet plays a viewport while idle
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Cannot approve without rendering: an unrendered facet stays dark and the report shows insufficient evidence

roles.name: Security Sentinel
roles.silhouette: Broad shielded figure with permission keys on a belt, a sealed secret vault on the back and probe filaments
roles.station: Boundary post with threat shadows, sealed secret vaults and trust-boundary probes
roles.workingRitual: Exposes unauthorised routes and injection vectors, closes compromised apertures by finding, never by editing; secret values never appear
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report with boundary and mitigation; escalates secrets and permission expansion to the owner
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Cannot expand permissions or reveal a secret: the vault has no display surface
roles.recognisableWithoutColour: Recognisable by the shield and vault

roles.name: Transport Inspector
roles.silhouette: Twin-bodied figure joined at the centre, one half facing the local dock and one the remote
roles.station: Mirrored local and remote docks with hash beacons, manifest plates and a parallax gap
roles.locomotion: Moves symmetrically on both sides at once
roles.workingRitual: Aligns byte signatures, hashes, manifests and SHAs; matching artifacts phase-lock, mismatches separate into a parallax split
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report with both hashes and the comparison
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: Cannot assert equality without hash evidence: the comparator has no manual override

roles.name: Performance Examiner
roles.ensembleRole: measurer in a temporal and gravimetric laboratory
roles.silhouette: Figure with a heavy pendulum instrument and frame-time gauges strapped along the arms
roles.station: Temporal and gravimetric laboratory surrounding the rendered world; frame time, memory, draw calls, loading, concurrency and device pressure visibly affect the instruments
roles.locomotion: Slow, weighted movements; instruments swing with load
roles.workingRitual: Measures against the defined budgets per device tier and reports by tier
roles.handoffBehaviour: Attaches a review report with measurements per tier
roles.idleBehaviour: Pendulum at rest and gauges zeroed; no measurement runs while idle
roles.prohibitedActionRepresentation: May test reduced tiers but the tier switch has no setting that removes role identity, evidence marks, state geometry, SHA identity, authority tokens, tethers or the owner gate; it cannot redefine the premium standard
